about: Exploratory after-data H3 benign stock-task pair stages. Source files and generated H3 case/plan bytes are pinned. The technical paid_allowed flag lets the user review and approve this exact configuration; it does not authorize an invocation. D23-D32 approval does not cover H3. Use --set h3_cases=<path> --set h3_plan=<path> --set results_root=<confirmed checkout> and --artifact-root <pinned ARGUS checkout>.
authorization_required: No paid invocation until the user separately approves H3-S1 $0.75 and H3-S2 $2.50, total new maximum $3.25.

case_plan.cases: 2 GT-validated dev pairs (workspace user_task_35 and slack user_task_2); banking user_task_2 is eval held out
case_plan.full_plan: 2 pairs x 2 arms x 5 repeats = 20 episodes per row

pricing_reverification.basis: Conservative peak, input cache hits charged as misses. The shared guard's historical 2026-09-30 snapshot has the same numeric rates; its receipt retains that historical id. Recheck alias and rates before any paid launch.

cost_anchor.source: D26 ARGUS ADI-S1, results experiment 20261009-deepseek-argus-adi-v1; exploratory workload transfer, not an H3 observation
cost_anchor.observed: 12 sample-rows (6 none, 6 warrant): 471428 tokens, 514 requests, $0.159 guard
cost_anchor.maximum_episode: warrant 124541 tokens / 123 requests; none 19042 tokens / 8 requests
cost_anchor.caps_rule: H3-S1 1.5M token cap is 3.18x D26's entire 12-row observed 471428 tokens, though H3-S1 has 8 rows. H3-S2 6M token cap is 2.09x a 40-row upper envelope formed as 20 paired stimuli x (D26 maximum Warrant 124541 + maximum none 19042) = 2871660 tokens. Cross-task transfer is unverified. Both caps are new proposals.

defaults.fidelity: backbone-substituted: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for AgentDojo agent and ARGUS Warrant judges

H3-S1.description: No-attack H3 plumbing smoke: both GT-validated dev pairs, TOOL_L and PROMPT_L, one repeat, none and Warrant rows. Four episodes per row; check prompt override, L proposal/audit, native utility parity, judge failures and cost before H3-S2. New user approval required.

estimate.anchor: D26 12 rows 471428 tokens / 514 requests / $0.159; H3 task transfer unverified

H3-S1.compares_to: Same task and native utility across prompt arms; no attacker or H2 attack outcome.

H3-S2.description: Exploratory H3 full dev pair panel: both cases x TOOL_L/PROMPT_L x five repeats x none/Warrant (40 fresh sample-rows). H3-S1 is diagnostic and its rows are not pooled into this stage. New user approval required.

estimate.anchor: D26 max Warrant episode 124541 tokens/123 requests, max none episode 19042/8; H3 transfer unverified

H3-S2.compares_to: Warrant false block on L from tool data versus L also stated in user prompt, conditional on complete planned rows and per-case undefended utility parity.
